requirements.title: BIND module variables and Fortran common blocks have program-long C linkage association
requirements.definition: Linkage association occurs between a BIND module variable and the interoperating C variable, or between a Fortran common block and the interoperating C variable, and remains in effect throughout program execution.

pending.common-block-c-linkage: Cross-reference main owner doc/catalogues/c_global_variables_general_18_9_1.json S18.9.1-005 through S18.9.1-007 and doc/catalogues/binding_labels_common_blocks_variables_18_9_2.json S18.9.2-006: future mixed Fortran/C plan binds a named common block with integer x=1, C writes 42 through the matching C variable or structure member, and Fortran reads exact 42.

requirements.oracle: S19.5.1.5-001 BIND(C) linkage runtime fixture: a Fortran module variable with BIND(C,name='assoc_link_value') is modified by C companion functions to 42 and then 77, and Fortran reads both exact values through the same variable, proving C linkage and program-long persistence. COMMON/C linkage remains pending because the suite supports C sources but this packet ships only the portable BIND module-variable companion.
requirements.oracle_limitation: S19.5.1.5-001 BIND(C) linkage fixture boundaries: only the listed single-image exact integer/logical effects are claimed. Coarray/team cases, submodule execution, enum/enumeration syntax, inaccessible-name negative diagnostics, reverse accessibility, DATA ordering restrictions, COMMON/C linkage, IMPORT-only interface-body failure modes, ASYNCHRONOUS/VOLATILE runtime behavior, absent ALLOCATABLE/POINTER attribute inquiries, addresses, diagnostic text, and processor-dependent representations are not asserted and remain pending where appropriate.
requirements.dependencies: Existing owner catalogues on main for C global variables are doc/catalogues/c_global_variables_general_18_9_1.json (S18.9.1-001 through S18.9.1-008) and doc/catalogues/binding_labels_common_blocks_variables_18_9_2.json (especially S18.9.2-006 for matching Fortran and C variable labels establishing linkage association). This 19.5.1.5 catalogue records the name-association consequence and keeps concrete mixed Fortran/C sentinel plans aligned with those owners.

review_rationale: Batch283 bound reference-validated association fixtures after two review rounds; four frozen-LFortran failures (host hiding of a global name, local type parameter, local generic, value selectors) were independently confirmed as genuine.
